expects.rule: The phone number is in the header as a tap-to-call link on every page, and next to the main button.
The first screen says what the business does and where (trade and town or area) in the headline.
Opening hours, address and service area are plain text and easy to find, with special closures stated.
One primary action (quote, appointment, call) with a short form: name, phone, a message.
Trust signals are real: licence or registration numbers, named reviews, before-and-after photographs of actual work.
Prices or a clear statement on how quotes work (free site visit, fixed price, from-prices) are published.
Emergency or out-of-hours availability is stated with the number to use.

traits: Of the 5 sites seen on a screenshot, 3 (DC, Alaskan, West Side) put a phone or call control on the first screen; the 3 others lead with an image and a headline.
2 of 5 put the trade and the place in the first headline (DC: Chorley and Lancashire; Alaskan: Arizona).
4 of 5 use real photographs of premises, staff, work or products (DC, Altufan, West Side, Steve); Alaskan uses an illustrated background.
3 of 5 use one typeface for the whole page (DC Satoshi, West Side Poppins, Steve Roboto); Altufan pairs a serif with Inter; Alaskan uses three.
One saturated accent colour on the main button: green #344c3a, orange #ff8e0a or #c33d04, blue #004795.
2 of 5 had a cookie box over the first screen on load (DC, Steve); hours and addresses sit lower, in text, on the 4 that state them.
Reviews or ratings with a platform named appear on 2 of 8 (DC, Alaskan); South Cliff shows a single patient review; LAVA, Rendezvous and South Cliff were checked from page text only.

sites.name: DC Carpentry & Construction
sites.why: Cream (#f4f1e9) page, nav with phone and a green (#344c3a) Free quote button, large white headline naming trade and area over a photo of a lit brick extension, two buttons (services, quote); cookie bar at the bottom. One typeface, Satoshi. Hours, address, projects and reviews lower.

sites.name: Altufan Ulu Law Office
sites.why: Law firm in Istanbul: dark grey-toned photograph of an office and meeting table, serif headline 'Trusted, fast and strategic legal services' at left, an outlined Our Story button and one sentence, six nav links and a TR switch. Victor Serif with Inter. Contact is below the first screen.

sites.name: West Side Pharmacy & Compounding
sites.why: Dark (#0c0f17) page with a left icon column (Call South Street, Call Military Road, Transfer to Us, Online Refill, Services), a banner photo of staff and a customer with 'Preventative Healthcare Solutions', and a row of video tiles. Poppins throughout. Hours and addresses as text lower.

sites.name: Alaskan Air Conditioning, Heating, Plumbing & Electrical
sites.why: Blue (#004795) screen with icicle edge: location picker, Book online here, nav, orange (#ff8e0a) phone button, 'over 7,000 reviews' with Google and Facebook stars, capital headline naming four trades and the state, Get a quote and Call buttons. Illustrated, no photograph.

sites.name: Steve the Bike Guy
sites.why: White header under a blue sale and moving banner, utility links (Schedule, Visit, Contact), black hero with a mountain bike photograph, 'New Bikes from SCOTT' in Roboto and an orange-red (#c33d04) button; cookie box over the lower left. Hours, address and phone in the footer; closure dates stated.

sites.name: LAVA dental
sites.why: One-page site for a dental studio in Riga: headline 'Dentistry that will make you smile', a Make an appointment button, phone, address and weekly hours as text, price list and FAQ in the menu, before-and-after photographs, language switch en/lv/ru. (not seen on a screenshot)

sites.name: South Cliff Dental Group
sites.why: Group of dental practices: headline 'Award Winning Dental Practices' above a grid of award and partner logos, a Call us now button that links to an emergency page rather than showing a number, no addresses or hours on the home page, one patient review. 3D navigation. (not seen on a screenshot)

sites.name: Rendezvous Barbers
sites.why: Toronto barbershops: headline on short hair styles, five shops each with its own address, phone number and Learn more link, hours listed (Mon-Fri 10-20), Book now buttons near the top and bottom (some link to #), photographs of barbers at work and client haircuts. (not seen on a screenshot)

avoid: A service-area list, testimonial or team section still filled with template placeholder text.
Booking buttons that link to '#' or to nothing.
A phone number visible only in the footer, or only as an image.
Stock photographs of smiling workers instead of the real work and premises.
Three consent checkboxes and five fields in a quote form for a first enquiry.
Opening hours missing, or displayed without closure notices.
Menus with a dozen entries and several dropdowns for a business with five services.
